summary: The study investigates the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) of AlAs using ethyldimethylamine alane (EDMAAl) as the aluminum source and arsine (AsH3) as the arsenic source. The research explores different self-limiting growth modes (1-, 2-, and 3-monolayer) and their dependence on growth temperature and precursor supply rates. The growth mechanisms are explained through the adsorbate inhibition model and the formation of metallic Al layers, with the surface configuration influenced by substrate temperature.
